rooms.name: Landing Pad
rooms.description: An icy platform buffeted by Arctic winds. Your shuttle hums behind you. The Decontamination Chamber lies to the north.

rooms.name: Decontamination Chamber
rooms.description: High-pressure jets spray a sanitizing mist as you enter. The facility's Main Hub is further north.

rooms.name: Main Hub
rooms.description: The central circular hall of the station. Corridors lead to Biology (West), Engineering (East), and the Command Center (North). A maintenance drone is hovering nearby.

npcs.name: Drone
npcs.description: A floating spherical robot with a blinking blue light.

dialogs.idle: Beep. Hub status: Nominal. Access to the Command Center requires Alpha Clearance.
dialogs.happy: Alpha Clearance confirmed. Unlocking Command Center bulkheads.

rooms.name: Biology Lab
rooms.description: Filled with microscopes and sealed canisters. To the south is the Greenhouse.

npcs.name: Scientist
npcs.description: Dr. Aris, looking exhausted behind safety goggles.

dialogs.neutral: I need my sample container from the storage room to finish this analysis.
dialogs.happy: Perfect! This sample will change everything.

rooms.name: Greenhouse
rooms.description: A humid room with artificial sunlight feeding rows of exotic plants. An Observation Deck is to the west.

items.name: card
items.description: An Alpha Clearance security card found near a planter.

rooms.name: Engineering Bay
rooms.description: Dominated by the massive fusion reactor. Corridors lead south to Living Quarters.

npcs.name: Engineer
npcs.description: A man covered in grease, holding a heavy wrench.

dialogs.busy: The reactor's acting up. If only I had my specialized toolkit from the storage room.

rooms.name: Living Quarters
rooms.description: A row of small, functional bunks. The Storage Room is to the east.

rooms.name: Storage Room
rooms.description: A large hangar filled with crates. You see tools and containers scattered around.

items.name: toolkit
items.description: A heavy box of specialized engineering tools.

rooms.name: Observation Deck
rooms.description: A wall of reinforced glass offers a view of the aurora borealis. It is breathtaking.

rooms.name: Command Center
rooms.description: The brain of the station. Banks of computers monitor everything. You have reached your destination and secured the facility!

items.name: logbook
items.description: The final mission logs of the station.
